name: segmented-control
title: Segmented Control
description: A liquid indicator: the leading edge springs ahead and the trailing edge catches up, so it stretches between segments — measured with onLayout to fit any label. Drag the selected segment to scrub. iOS pill, tab underline and outline looks, with icons and three sizes.
props: Segments. `icon` can be a node or ({ active, color }) => node.
Controlled selection (or use defaultValue; defaults to the first segment).
Raised pill on a track, tab underline, or tinted outline.
Equal-width segments filling the row, or segments sized to their labels.
Indicator colour (pill becomes a filled accent pill).
Style for the track holding the segments.
